changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Refuse to install the physical-locator authority until operators resolve every source/schema/table duplicate. The exception contains a bounded repair list.
changeSet.sql: DO $locator_audit$ DECLARE duplicate_locators text; BEGIN SELECT string_agg(locator, ', ' ORDER BY locator) INTO duplicate_locators FROM ( SELECT format( '%s:%s.%s(count=%s)', source_id, lower(btrim(hive_database)), lower(btrim(hive_table)), count(*) ) AS locator FROM catalog_dataset WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL AND nullif(btrim(hive_database), '') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(btrim(hive_table), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source_id, lower(btrim(hive_database)), lower(btrim(hive_table)) HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY source_id, lower(btrim(hive_database)), lower(btrim(hive_table)) LIMIT 20 ) duplicates; IF duplicate_locators IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CATALOG_DATASET_PHYSICAL_LOCATOR_DUPLICATES_EXIST: %', duplicate_locators; END IF; END $locator_audit$;

changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_catalog_dataset_physical_locator ON catalog_dataset ( source_id, lower(btrim(hive_database)), lower(btrim(hive_table)) ) WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL AND nullif(btrim(hive_database), '') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(btrim(hive_table), '') IS NOT NULL;
